title: Sahel Climate Actions: A Great Green Wall Multi-Actor Serious Game Prototype
description: A five-role cooperative-competitive institutional serious-game prototype for Tabletop Simulator modelling coordination among public authority, technical assistance, territorial investment, agriculture and pastoral systems under climate, water and land-restoration pressures in the Sahel. This release is a TTS Human Playtest Candidate and includes a Lua Guided Turn Manager. Independently developed for research, design, portfolio and human-playtest purposes; no institutional endorsement is implied.
